firewall.title: Dynamic Firewall Manager
firewall.noElevation: ⚠️ This feature requires administrator privileges. Run as a service (LocalSystem) in production, or start Node.js as Administrator in development.
firewall.notWindows: ⚠️ Dynamic firewall management is only supported on Windows.
firewall.nextActionNone: No further action is needed right now.
firewall.nextActionApply: The policy is enabled, but the rules are not fully written yet. Run Sync All Rules first.
firewall.nextActionReviewResidual: Core rules are active, but residual rules remain. Review the advanced rule list.
firewall.nextActionRemoveResidual: If these old rules are no longer needed, remove all rules.
firewall.nextActionNeedElevation: Restart the panel with administrator privileges before applying or removing rules.
firewall.nextActionUnsupported: This feature is only available on Windows hosts.
firewall.nextActionRefresh: Refresh the status first to confirm current rules and privileges.
firewall.autoManage: Auto-apply rules on game server start
firewall.autoManageHint: Automatically run Sync All Rules each time the game server starts
firewall.removeOnStop: Auto-remove rules on game server stop
firewall.removeOnStopHint: Automatically remove game-port rules after the game server stops, while keeping management-port rules
firewall.openGamePorts: Game ports (opens ServerPort for TCP+UDP and ServerPort+1~+3 for UDP)
firewall.openMgmtPorts: Management ports (uses configured Backend/Telnet/WebDashboard TCP ports)
firewall.scopeGameHint: Player connectivity mainly depends on this rule set.
firewall.scopeMgmtHint: Enable only when remote maintenance is required to avoid exposing extra entry points.
firewall.mgmtPortsLocalOnlyReason: Management port settings can only be changed from localhost to avoid cutting off your own remote session.
firewall.rulesManagedHint: The default view shows only day-to-day decision data; raw names stay in the advanced section.
firewall.advancedSummary: Show advanced rules and raw names
firewall.summaryUnsupported: Dynamic management is only available on Windows
firewall.detailUnsupported: This section describes local Windows Firewall state only, not router or NAT state.
firewall.summaryNoPermission: Windows Firewall cannot be modified right now
firewall.detailNoPermission: You can still adjust policy, but applying or removing rules now requires administrator privileges.
firewall.detailUnmanaged: The current policy does not require any firewall rules to be opened.
firewall.summaryUnmanagedResidual: Management is disabled, but residual rules still exist
firewall.detailUnmanagedResidual: The current policy does not require any rules, but Windows Firewall still contains {count} old rules.
firewall.detailActive: Expected rules match the actual rules in Windows Firewall.
firewall.detailPending: The policy is enabled, but the corresponding rules have not been written to Windows Firewall yet.
firewall.detailPartial: Some rules exist and some are still missing. Check the detailed rule table.
firewall.detailRefreshFailed: Unable to retrieve the latest Windows Firewall status.
firewall.ruleStatePending: Should be active but is missing
firewall.stateExcludedExisting: Excluded from policy, but the rule still exists in Windows Firewall.

saves.title: Save Management
saves.importUpload: Import (Upload ZIP - refer to exported ZIP for structure)
saves.homeSelectionEmpty: Select a world or save first
saves.fullSavesSectionDesc: Actions in this section apply to the whole Saves root, not a single save.
saves.exportAllDesc: Export a full backup of all worlds and saves under the Saves directory.
saves.exportOneDesc: Export only the save selected above, or delete it (a backup is created automatically before deletion).
saves.selectionSectionDesc: Choose a world and save first, then run the action you need.
saves.singleSaveSectionDesc: Actions in this section apply only to the currently selected world / save.
saves.deleteGameNameDesc: A backup is created automatically before deletion. Verify the selected save first.
saves.fullBackupListDesc: Manage backups of the entire Saves root. Only full-backup ZIP packages are accepted here.
saves.fullUploadDesc: Upload a full backup ZIP and import it. This replaces the current Saves root.
saves.singleBackupListDesc: Manage single-save backups. Only world / save ZIP packages are accepted here.
saves.singleUploadDesc: Upload a single-save ZIP and import it. Only the matching world / save is replaced.
saves.backupManagementHint: Review existing backups and restore or delete them when needed.
saves.importUploadHint: Upload your own ZIP package and verify its structure before replacing existing saves.
saves.applyActiveSaveTitle: Write the selected save to serverconfig.xml's GameWorld/GameName so the next server start loads it
